:::{#def-differential-entropy}
#### Differential entropy

The **differential entropy** of a
[continuous random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-continuous-rv) $X$
with [density](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-pdf) $f$
is the [expectation](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-expectation)
of its [surprisal](#def-surprisal-continuous), when that expectation exists
[@cover2006elements, section 8.1]:

$$h(X) \eqdef \E{\surprisalf{X}} = -\int_{\set{x : f(x) > 0}} f(x) \log f(x) \, dx.$$

:::
